JN.Vault.ModeHelp:
Passphrase (recommended). Secrets are encrypted with a key only your passphrase opens. Players' browsers receive the encrypted vault but can't read it. Use something long, like four or five random words: anyone who copies the vault can try guesses offline.

No passphrase. Secrets are still encrypted, but the key sits next to them, so a player who opens the browser console can read everything. It only stops casual peeking.
